display_name: Regulatory Gap Intake and Surfacing Proposals
description: Prepare evidence-linked regulatory gap intake, deduplication, and owner-notice proposals from an authorized policy diff.

provenance.author: LiNKskills adaptation
provenance.source: Pinned source methodology and source context/license preserved with per-file hashes in references/upstream/SOURCE-MANIFEST.json
provenance.license: See exact per-source license copy and declared term in SOURCE-MANIFEST.json; no independent publication clearance or license opinion asserted.

routing.when_to_use: Use when a policy diff needs evidence-linked gap intake, deduplication, or a draft owner notice.
when_not_to_use: Full register status, close, or risk-acceptance proposal; use legal-regulatory-gaps.
Final legal applicability decision or official tracker update.
exclusion_rules: No register writes or official status changes
ambiguity_rules: Use supplied diff/register snapshot only; preserve missing scope and authority checks

required_inputs.name: policy_diff
required_inputs.description: Authorized policy diff and its limitations.

required_inputs.name: register_snapshot
required_inputs.description: Authorized read-only tracker snapshot and schema.

required_inputs.name: scope_and_owner_context
required_inputs.description: Organization scope, role and owner context.

forbidden_actions: No close/accept decision, register write, notification, filing, publication or legal advice.
verification_steps: Verify requirement source/status or mark unverified.
Carry source scope limits into derived proposals.
completion_criteria: Task-shaped proposal with evidence links and visible scope gaps.
No official update or message sent.
A completed_draft populates the non-empty task-specific fields in references/task-contract-shape-fixture.json and cites evidence.
A needs_context response records missing_inputs, unknown_facts and any separable partial_work without fabricating completion.
known_limitations: Structural validation does not establish legal correctness, current law, semantic behavior, or runtime availability.

telemetry.retention_policy: retain opaque task/source ids and hashes only
